display.purpose: Hero headings on the landing page only. Never inside the dashboard.

headline.purpose: Page titles and major section headings.

label.purpose: Section labels, table headers (700 weight, 0.10em tracking).

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Resting card shadow with oxblood tint.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: #6b1f2a; color: #faf8f4; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(107,31,42,0.35); transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7c2535; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b1f2a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action, paired with primary buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid #6b1f2a; color: #6b1f2a; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(107,31,42,0.08); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b1f2a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: Content containers with oxblood top stripe and resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #faf8f4; border: 1px solid #ccc4ba; border-top: 5px solid #6b1f2a; border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(107,31,42,0.10), 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Text field for forms and search.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #ccc4ba; color: #1a1714; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #6b1f2a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6b1f2a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #b0a496; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Status Pill (Dispatched)
components.description: Order status indicator for dispatched/delivered states.
components.html: DISPATCHED PENDING DELIVERED
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-pill-dispatched { background: #f0dde0; color: #6b1f2a; border-color: #d4b0b5; } .ds-pill-pending { background: #fdf3e3; color: #92600a; border-color: #f0d090; } .ds-pill-delivered { background: #eaf3de; color: #3b6d11; border-color: #b8d89a; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Navigation link in the dashboard sidebar.
components.html: My Cards
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; color: #8a7e72; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(107,31,42,0.08); color: #6b1f2a; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status badge for admin roles, tags.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 8px; background: #f0dde0; border: 1px solid #d4b0b5; color: #6b1f2a; font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: CardBranch's visual system is refined, bold, and professional without trying. It lives on a warm paper foundation anchored by a deep oxblood accent that signals quality, craft, and permanence. Oxblood appears in the nav bar, on card accent stripes, in avatars, badges, and CTAs. Cards carry a signature oxblood top stripe with a warm-tinted shadow for subtle depth. Gold remains reserved for the card product preview and checkout flow.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper foundation (#f0ebe4), card surfaces in warm white (#faf8f4).
Oxblood (#6b1f2a) as the house colour across nav, cards, badges, avatars, and CTAs.
Cards with signature oxblood top stripe and resting warm-tinted shadow.
DM Serif Display for headings, Inter for body.
Generous spacing in brand, efficient in product.
Gold (#c9a84c) reserved for card preview and checkout.

rules.name: The House Colour Rule
rules.body: Oxblood (#6b1f2a) is the single brand signal. Used deliberately across nav, card stripes, avatars, badges, and CTAs. Presence is the point.

rules.name: The Card Stripe Rule
rules.body: Every card carries a 5px oxblood top stripe. It is non-negotiable. The stripe + shadow + 10px radius define the container.

rules.name: The Product-Scoped Detail Rule
rules.body: Gold (#c9a84c) belongs to the card view and checkout only. Never used as a system accent beyond those surfaces.

dos: Do use oxblood as the dominant accent across nav, cards, badges, and CTAs.
Do apply the 5px oxblood top stripe to every card container.
Do use card-stripe class for all card surfaces (stripe + shadow + radius).
Do use DM Serif Display for headings and Inter for UI.
Do keep gold confined to card view and checkout.
Do respect the split-register: the landing page breathes; the dashboard is efficient.
donts: Don't use gold outside the card view and checkout flow.
Don't remove the oxblood card stripe.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradients, glow effects, or neon.
Don't use pure white (#ffffff) as a page background.
Don't make it look cheap or DIY.
Don't use uppercase for body copy.
Don't over-round: cards at 10px, buttons at 4px.
